payload.markdown: Lazy loading is a good habit to get into, whether or not you explicitly add deferred loading logic to your domain classes. Over and above type safety, the particular benefit of using a collection rather than an array for your properties is the opportunity this gives you to retrofit lazy loading should you need it.

items: Classes & Objects: A class defines state and behaviour; objects are instances of that definition.
Properties & Methods: Class state held in properties, and behaviour implemented as methods.
Abstract Classes: A partial base class that forces subclasses to complete certain methods.
Dynamic Properties: Creating properties by assignment instead of declaration; deprecated since PHP 8.
Type Coercion: PHP converting a value between types, silently unless strict_types is declared.
Type Declarations: Parameter and return types that constrain what a function accepts and returns.
Type-Checking Functions: is_*, gettype and friends that inspect a value type at runtime.
